verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox. It has its own frontend (demo.ramp.com) and API base (demo-api.ramp.com), with no real money movement, and simulated events via a demo actions panel. Agent tooling is wired to it: the CLI defaults to sandbox, Ramp MCP works against sandbox accounts, and there is a separate demo MCP endpoint (demo-mcp.ramp.com). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox and demo MCP work as documented.
